newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power falls on cool weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power falls on cool weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the U.S. Mid-Atlantic were generally weaker Friday on forecasts of cool weather and moderate demand over the weekend, brokers and traders said.
"People are looking for bargains," said a Houston trader.
The earlier-than-expected return of Peach Bottom 2 nuclear unit also pressured spot power prices in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool lower.
The 1,100 megawatt (MW) unit in Delta, Pa., was expected to resume full output Monday, more than a week ahead of its refueling outage schedule, said the operator PECO Energy Co.
